entries.description: Atha kho aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṁ andhavanaṁ obhāsetvā yenāyasmā kumārakassapo tenupasaṅkami
entries.subject: Atha
entries.object: aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṁ andhavanaṁ obhāsetvā yenāyasmā kumārakassapo tenupasaṅkami

spans.text: Atha kho aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṁ andhavanaṁ obhāsetvā yenāyasmā kumārakassapo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṁ aṭṭhāsi.

Picking up the sword and digging, the clever one saw a bullfrog: Atha kho āyasmā kumārakassapo tassā rattiyā accayena yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi.

entries.description: Abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṁ ādāya addasa dvidhāpathaṁ
entries.subject: Abhikkhaṇanto

spans.text: Abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṁ ādāya addasa dvidhāpathaṁ.
Abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṁ ādāya addasa caṅgavāraṁ.
Abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṁ ādāya addasa kummaṁ.
Abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṁ ādāya addasa asisūnaṁ.
Abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṁ ādāya addasa maṁsapesiṁ.
Abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṁ ādāya addasa nāgaṁ.
Abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṁ ādāya addasa uddhumāyikaṁ.
Abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṁ ādāya …pe…
Ime kho tvaṁ, bhikkhu, pañhe bhagavantaṁ upasaṅkamitvā puccheyyāsi, yathā ca te bhagavā byākaroti tathā naṁ dhāreyyāsi.

entries.description: the Prince went to the Buddha
entries.subject: the Prince

spans.text: Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā kumārakassapo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca: Then, when the night had passed, Kassapa the Prince went to the Buddha, bowed, sat down to one side, and told him what had happened.
